walkthroughs.body_html:
Primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13…

Factor tree of 60 → 2 × 30 → 2 × 2 × 15 → 2 × 2 × 3 × 5. So 60 = 2² × 3 × 5.

Common conversions: ½ = 0.5, ¼ = 0.25, ⅛ = 0.125.

To add fractions, find a common denominator. ⅓ + ¼ = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12.

aᵐ × aⁿ = a^(m+n). aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = a^(m−n). (aᵐ)ⁿ = a^(mn).

a⁰ = 1. a⁻ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ. Example: 2³ × 2² = 2⁵ = 32.
